It reflects the Hindu belief in the pursuit of spiritual growth and self-realization. data.spiritual_significance: The name Mukti has profound spiritual significance in Hinduism as it symbolizes the attainment of self-realization and union with the divine. It represents the idea that every soul is eternal and free to choose its own path, and that the ultimate goal is to break free from the cycle of birth and rebirth through spiritual growth and self-realization. The name Mukti serves as a reminder of the spiritual journey that lies ahead for every individual and is a powerful inspiration for a lifelong pursuit of personal growth and spiritual enlightenment.
